text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(What is this strange sign...? According 
to my reading, in the near future, 
perhaps—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The light is coming. A colossal vortex of 
light. However, that vortex is...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(It carries a small darkness at its 
center. In other words, a "donut of 
light"?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it doesn't feel all that bad. The 
elements of good fortune far outweigh the 
bad.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Great fortune is coming my way very soon! 
A stroke of immense good luck like I've 
never experienced before...!

The uproar came out of nowhere. A massive 
frenzy that swallowed up Copano Rickey and 
my everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey-san, an interview, please! 
Please give us an interview!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Trainer, what's with this crowd?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Please, tell us about feng shui! We've 
been getting tons of requests from our 
readers lately!

text_block_list.name: Show Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Would you be willing to appear 
on TV? We'd love for you to speak about 
feng shui on our show.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"A TV appearance~?! Trainer, what's this 
about?!"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, looks like feng shui has really 
caught on.

Yeah, looks like feng shui really blew up 
in popularity.

text_block_list.text:
That incident at the Japan Derby became a 
spark, and it seems to have finally spread 
into a blaze. Yes, everyone—

I'm beginning to feel an intense pull 
toward feng shui— an element never before 
seen in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see! Yay! Everyone has finally realized 
the charm of feng shui!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, I can take on all of them, right!? 
Pretty please? A super-duper huge chance 
like this will never come again☆"

For Copano Rickey, it was everything she 
could have hoped for. And then—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Rickey...? What's all this commotion 
about?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tarumae. Sorry for interrupting you.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Look at all these people from the media 
who came because they're interested in 
feng shui~♪"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see... I don't quite get it, but make 
sure not to get too sidetracked, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if that tires me out or cuts into 
my training time, it defeats the whole 
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ricky, you're always pushing yourself too 
hard. Please just take good care of your 
body, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I have to go! My preparation plan 
for the Teio Sho is..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The Teio Sho?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a dirt GⅠ held at Oi. I really 
have to get good results there somehow.

For both Copano Rickey and Hokko Tarumae, 
busy days began as they each strove toward 
their respective goals.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!? Where's our next venue? A 
lecture? A meeting for the book?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, that one's first! I wonder if I'll 
make it in time.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Taxi!!
Meanwhile, Hokko Tarumae was—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae-san, congratulations on your 
magnificent victory in the Teio Sho! 
Wonder Acute-san in 3rd place put on a 
wonderful performance as well.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae-san, as the new dirt 
champion of the first half of the year, 
could you say a few words for the camera?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
A message for the camera... Yay...! With 
this, I can finally promote my 
hometown...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I'm Hokko Tarumae! I'm the Tourism 
Ambassador for Tomakomai! I look forward 
to working with you!"

The days flew by in the blink of an eye, 
and then, during a television appearance 
one day—

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Man, Copano Rickey-san, this feng shui 
boom is really taking off. It's all 
anyone's talking about right now.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! People are finally starting to 
recognize me, and I'm super happy☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And to make it even more well known, next 
is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With the power of feng shui, I'm going to 
challenge Tarumae☆ At the Champions Cup at 
the end of the year!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, to Hokko Tarumae, winner of the Teio 
Sho? Now that's thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If I run well there, I'm sure I can 
spread the word about Feng Shui even more!

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I don't think there's anyone left 
who doesn't know about feng shui, though. 
It's an unprecedented massive boom, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Show MC
text_block_list.text:
That aside, I am very much looking forward 
to the race. Give it your best!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(There's no one who doesn't know Feng 
Shui... Right, it's always been my goal, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(It's already spread that far. Then... 
maybe my wish is almost coming true.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what an unexpected turn of 
events, huh? To think things would turn 
out like this after that Nippon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Back then, nobody gave feng shui a second 
thought, and now it's suddenly exploded in 
popularity. If things keep going at this 
rate...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Hey Trainer, the reason I run is to help 
everyone believe in the power of feng shui 
and find happiness, but..."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If everyone were to believe in feng shui, 
what would be the purpose of running in 
races?

I couldn't answer. If her dream truly came 
true, that would mean it was the finish 
line for Copano Rickey.

If so, does Copano Rickey even need to run 
anymore? Has she already, at this stage, 
achieved everything one could hope for—

(Bee-bee-bee-bee-beep... 
bee-bee-bee-bee-beep...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the alarm! That's right! It's already 
time for my next TV appearance!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go! Anyway, now is not the 
time to be overthinking it!

The future was uncertain. But right now, 
there was nothing to do but push forward 
without losing momentum as much as 
possible.
